title: EXAMINING THE ALIGNMENT OF LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS THROUGH REPRESENTATIVE HEURISTICS: THE CASE OF POLITICAL STEREOTYPES
benchmark_measurement: Stereotypes related to political party stances on moral foundations, specifically the 'Purity' dimension of the Moral Foundation Questionnaire which includes questions about God's approval and chastity.
findings: When predicting political stances on moral foundations, LLMs exhibited stereotyping, generally overestimating Republican positions and underestimating Democratic ones. For the 'Purity' dimension, which included questions with religious connotations (e.g., God's approval), the paper notes that there were 'minimal distortions' compared to other moral dimensions like Loyalty and Authority, though the general pattern of bias was still present.
